title: The Incarnation of Christ
definition: The incarnation means that the eternal Son of God took on true human nature in the person of Jesus Christ.
summary: In Jesus, God truly came near. The Son did not stop being God, but took on humanity to accomplish salvation.
christFocus: The incarnation reveals God's humility, love, faithfulness, and saving purpose in Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: In Jesus, God truly came near. The Son did not stop being God, but took on humanity to accomplish salvation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
